name: Nadiral-Apse
description: A killed landscape, vacuum-scoured and silent. The regolith holds bootprints beautifully; there are some near petrified remnants of a former biosphere that no expedition has ever claimed.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Around the signal of unknown origin, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Whoever controls platinum controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
